en: When did you become so strong?
It seems I underestimated your power...
If the dawn finds me with this mortal wound,
And I shall be freed from eternal suffering...
No... it will not be so.
For a Vampir, there is no means of escape
come to taste that same suffering...

when I come home with a bride...
But I've made up my mind.
Rose, I'm going to marry you.
Let's go to my castle together.
In time, I'll formally welcome you to the clan.
It seems you'll only learn the hard way.
